apply_diff_to_code: apply a SEARCH/REPLACE diff to original source code and return the modified code
extract_diffs_from_text: extract SEARCH/REPLACE diff blocks from text and return a list of search and replace tuples
parse_evolve_blocks: parse evolve blocks marked with EVOLVE-BLOCK-START and EVOLVE-BLOCK-END comments from source code
parse_full_rewrite: extract a full code rewrite from an LLM response by parsing fenced code blocks
calculate_edit_distance: calculate the Levenshtein edit distance between two code snippets to measure their similarity
